objectives.text: Assess whether the bank has designed, implemented, and maintains an adequate BSA/AML compliance program that complies with BSA regulatory requirements.

citations.quote: Objective: Assess whether the bank has designed, implemented, and maintains an adequate BSA/AML compliance program that complies with BSA regulatory requirements.

obligations.action: establish and maintain procedures reasonably designed to assure and monitor compliance with BSA regulatory requirements (BSA/AML compliance program)

citations.quote: Banks must establish and maintain procedures reasonably designed to assure and monitor compliance with BSA regulatory requirements (BSA/AML compliance program).

obligations.action: have the BSA/AML compliance program be written, approved by the board of directors, and noted in the board minutes

citations.quote: The BSA/AML compliance program[10] must be written, approved by the board of directors,[11] and noted in the board minutes.

obligations.action: make the BSA/AML compliance program commensurate with the bank's ML/TF and other illicit financial activity risk profile
obligations.trigger: To achieve the purposes of the BSA

citations.quote: To achieve the purposes of the BSA, the BSA/AML compliance program should be commensurate with the bank's ML/TF and other illicit financial activity risk profile.

obligations.action: align policies, procedures, processes, and practices with the bank's unique ML/TF and other illicit financial activity risk profile

citations.quote: policies, procedures, processes, and practices should align with the bank's unique ML/TF and other illicit financial activity risk profile.

obligations.action: provide for a system of internal controls to assure ongoing compliance

citations.quote:
The BSA/AML compliance program must provide for the following requirements:[12]

A system of internal controls to assure ongoing compliance.

obligations.action: provide for independent testing for compliance to be conducted by bank personnel or by an outside party

citations.quote: Independent testing for compliance to be conducted by bank personnel or by an outside party.

obligations.action: provide for designation of an individual or individuals responsible for coordinating and monitoring day-to-day compliance (BSA compliance officer)

citations.quote: Designation of an individual or individuals responsible for coordinating and monitoring day-to-day compliance (BSA compliance officer).

obligations.action: provide for training for appropriate personnel

citations.quote: Training for appropriate personnel.

obligations.action: include a customer identification program (CIP) with risk-based procedures that enable the bank to form a reasonable belief that it knows the true identity of its customers

citations.quote: the BSA/AML compliance program must include a customer identification program (CIP) with risk-based procedures that enable the bank to form a reasonable belief that it knows the true identity of its customers.

obligations.action: include appropriate risk-based procedures for conducting ongoing customer due diligence (CDD) and complying with beneficial ownership requirements for legal entity customers as set forth in regulations issued by FinCEN

citations.quote: The BSA/AML compliance program must also include appropriate risk-based procedures for conducting ongoing customer due diligence (CDD) and complying with beneficial ownership requirements for legal entity customers as set forth in regulations issued by Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN).

obligations.action: consider all pertinent information when assessing the adequacy of the bank's BSA/AML compliance program

citations.quote: The assessment of the adequacy of the bank's BSA/AML compliance program is bank-specific, and examiners should consider all pertinent information.

obligations.action: discuss BSA/AML examination findings with relevant bank management

citations.quote: BSA/AML examination findings should be discussed with relevant bank management

obligations.action: include findings in the report of examination (ROE) or supervisory correspondence

citations.quote: findings must be included in the report of examination (ROE) or supervisory correspondence.

obligations.action: develop and document a preliminary assessment of the bank's program
obligations.trigger: Once examiners complete the review of the bank's BSA/AML compliance program

citations.quote: Once examiners complete the review of the bank's BSA/AML compliance program, they should develop and document a preliminary assessment of the bank's program.

obligations.action: revisit the initial BSA/AML examination plan to determine whether additional areas of review are necessary to assess the adequacy of the bank's BSA/AML compliance program, relative to its risk profile, and the bank's compliance with BSA regulatory requirements

citations.quote: At this point, examiners should revisit the initial BSA/AML examination plan to determine whether additional areas of review are necessary to assess the adequacy of the bank's BSA/AML compliance program, relative to its risk profile, and the bank's compliance with BSA regulatory requirements.

obligations.action: document and support any changes to the examination plan, if necessary, then proceed to the applicable examination and testing procedures

citations.quote: Examiners should document and support any changes to the examination plan, if necessary, then proceed to the applicable examination and testing procedures in Assessing Compliance with BSA Regulatory Requirements, Risks Associated with Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, and Office of Foreign Assets Control.

obligations.action: proceed to Developing Conclusions and Finalizing the Examination
obligations.trigger: Once all relevant examination and testing procedures are completed as documented in the examination plan

citations.quote: Once all relevant examination and testing procedures are completed as documented in the examination plan, examiners should proceed to Developing Conclusions and Finalizing the Examination.

notes: Source is FFIEC supervisory guidance (examination manual), evidence role supervisory_guidance; it restates program/'pillars' obligations rather than being the primary regulation. Actor for many program obligations is stated as 'Banks'/'the BSA/AML compliance program' rather than the specific covered institution; preserved as written. The four listed pillar requirements are introduced by a single 'must provide for the following requirements' stem — modality 'must' applied to each list item per the stem. Footnote markers ([9]-[12]) appear in source but referenced authorities are not reproduced in this text. CIP, CDD, and beneficial ownership are treated in scope here as the manual frames them as part of the mandatory program content; the ratified scope treats CDD as a coordination layer, but this text embeds them as program-establishment obligations, so extracted as written and flagged. OFAC/sanctions referenced only as a cross-reference (boundary regime).
